name: What factors influence the cost of building a custom ADU?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of building a custom ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a custom ADU is influenced by several factors, including its size, the complexity of the design, the quality of materials selected, and site-specific conditions like utility access or challenging terrain. Foundation requirements, the type of finishes (e.g., standard vs. high-end), and the need for significant tree removal or grading can also impact the overall budget. We can provide a detailed breakdown once initial design concepts and site assessments are completed.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU costs depend on size, design complexity, material quality, and site conditions, including utility access and specific finish choices.
